name: Task-conditioned finite-horizon Navier-Stokes retained RK4 dependency compiler

statement.latest: D(S)=S\cup\{p,q\in K_M:p+q=k\text{ for some }k\in S\};\quad K_4=T,\ K_3=D(K_4),\ K_2=D(K_3),\ K_1=D(K_2),\ S_{in}=D(K_1)
statement.note_ascii: Exact finite-RK4 dependency pullback: terminal T -> K4 -> K3 -> K2 -> K1 -> S_in using the NS ordered-triad relation p+q=k.

parents.evidence: The finite NS shell/tape adapter instantiates the retained-response interface, but the dependency compiler itself does not modify tau_R dI_R/dt + L_R I_R = S_R + eta_R; it slices the declared finite NS computation graph by terminal readout relevance.

origin.note: Retroactive proposal registration after executable finite diagnostics. This entry records lineage only and does not promote the finite checker to a continuum theorem.

resistance_evidence.evidence: Retained/full terminal RK4 readout agreement is checked to a declared 1e-12 numerical gate on fixed finite Fourier-Galerkin cases; backend selection is fail-closed against full RK4 when retained calibration is not cheaper.

name: Readout Design as Computational Acceleration for finite Navier-Stokes tasks

statement.note_ascii: Among physical readers admissible for a declared task, choose the reader whose exact RK4 NS backward dependency cone has minimum declared structural work.

parents.evidence: C_H(Q) is computed from the exact stage-wise and horizon-wise dependency sets generated by the PROP-NSRFC-01 compiler.

origin.note: Design objective recorded after point, plane-average, and harmonic readers were found to have different exact causal-cone growth. It is an optimization target, not a theorem of existence, uniqueness, or global optimality.

finite_examples: exact point velocity has dense terminal support S_Q=K_M
plane-average support is sparse but satisfies D(A_x)=K_M
tested K=3 corner harmonic probe has RK4 stage sizes 342,342,126,2 and structural work reduction about 1.658x
claim_boundary: no proof that an optimizer Q* exists for arbitrary task families
no proof that the tested corner harmonic reader is globally optimal
structural work reduction is not identical to wall-clock speed-up

name: Exact real physical harmonic Navier-Stokes reader

statement.note_ascii: A real physical-space harmonic measurement reads exactly the conjugate Fourier pair +/-k0 in the fixed finite periodic representation.

parents.evidence: The harmonic reader is one admitted physical-reader family on which exact dependency-cone cost can be evaluated.
